##### Project general facts

Trevino by Avelon Developments is a low-rise boutique residential building that brings contemporary architecture and a tranquil natural setting together. Its tiered design creates a cascading composition of levels, where architecture, landscape and comfort meet, and enhances the connection between indoor and outdoor spaces. The building rises above a ground floor and a podium to five residential floors, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments with views over the surrounding green belt.

Residents enjoy a resort-style pool with poolside sun loungers and a rooftop infinity pool with open views of the community. A fitness centre and a clubhouse support an active and social routine, while a rooftop meditation zone and a rooftop barbecue area offer calm places to relax. A children's play area, a landscaped garden and a welcoming lobby complete the shared spaces, creating a refined and peaceful environment for residents and guests.

Interiors are designed with an emphasis on comfort and aesthetics, with large windows that fill the living spaces with soft natural light. Efficient layouts make the most of every square foot, while balconies extend the living space outdoors. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and built-in appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and making every apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a vibrant, family-friendly community at the centre of the city, known for its circular layout of landscaped parks, low- and mid-rise residential buildings and townhouses. Circle Mall, the JVC park network, neighbourhood cafes, supermarkets, nurseries, schools and clinics cover daily needs close to home and give the community a green, relaxed character.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road connect residents with the wider city. Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Hills Mall are a short drive away, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence and Mall of the Emirates are close by, and Palm Jumeirah, Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Jumeirah Village Circle is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular rental markets in Dubai. A central position between the coastal districts and the inland business hubs attracts young professionals and families, supporting high occupancy and steady demand. Boutique buildings with resort-style amenities and competitive prices underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners.
